subject.title: refactor(sessions): move inbound meta, goals, and delivery reads behind the session accessor

question: Should maintainers land this accessor-seam slice independently after proof and exact-head validation, or fold it into the remaining session/transcript storage-migration plan?
rationale: The PR is behavior-preserving in intent, but it touches protected session-state, delivery, and SDK surfaces, while the older full storage-flip PR is closed and no longer a safe superseding path.

options.title: Land after proof
options.body: Require real behavior proof plus exact-head CI/review, then land this narrow accessor-seam slice as part of the tracker cleanup.

options.title: Fold into replacement flip
options.body: Hold this branch and absorb the same seam work into a maintainer-approved replacement for the broader storage migration.

options.title: Pause until tracker refresh
options.body: Keep this PR open but wait for the canonical tracker to name the new storage-migration lane before reviewing merge readiness.

recommendation.title: Land after proof
recommendation.body: Require real behavior proof plus exact-head CI/review, then land this narrow accessor-seam slice as part of the tracker cleanup.
